payload.reason: The evidence provides methods for obtaining psychological dimensions through language analysis and mapping demographic and psycholinguistic properties from a large dataset of blog posts.

claims.text: Psychological dimensions can be obtained by analyzing language usage in social media, which reflects personality and motivations.
Maps can be generated to reflect psycholinguistic and semantic properties based on the distribution of words in specific categories.
The Meaning Extraction Method (MEM) allows for the identification of themes related to personal values, which can indicate psychological dimensions.
